displayTitle: Ash-Lad and the Troll’s Silver Ducks, Bedspread, and Gold Harp
description: His jealous brothers volunteer him for one impossible theft after another, and Ash-Lad just answers “Ye-es” and rows back across the lake. The Norwegian classic, told in lively modern English.
summary: Ash-Lad outwits a troll three times and wins the silver ducks, the bedspread, the golden harp and the princess.
